column1: # scope_delegations.tsv
# Scope-boundary record (operation #15). Unlike facet_decomposition.tsv — which
# records LOSSLESS faceting INSIDE ONGA (a compound content term = base + ONGA
# facets) — this file records SCOPE EJECTIONS: compound content terms whose
# qualifier names a property that is OUT of ONGA's content scope and is
# DELEGATED to an external ontology / module.
# Anatomy/tissue (forebrain, heart, brain) is a biospecimen property, not a
# property of what a file's content IS. The 3 `predicted <tissue> enhancers`
# FeatureType terms collapse onto the already-existing content base
# `predicted enhancers`; the tissue is ejected to UBERON and aligns with the
# future `organism_part` slot of the biospecimen module (FAIRtracks
# sample.sample_type.organism_part, UBERON range).
# This file is the lossless scope-boundary record: the removed compound term is
# recoverable as content_base + delegated_axis:delegated_value(external_curie).
# The website will later render redirects / delegation notes from it.
# Columns:
#   encode_term     the removed compound content term
#   content_enum    which ONGA content enum it was removed from
#   content_base    the atomic content base it collapses onto (must exist)
#   delegated_axis  the out-of-scope axis name (aligns to a biospecimen slot)
#   delegated_value the human-readable value of that axis
#   external_curie  the external ontology term the value is delegated to
#   note            short rationale
